name: Open Catalyst 2022 (OC22)
description: A dataset for machine-learning research on electrocatalyst materials, containing density-functional-theory relaxations and energies for catalyst surfaces and adsorbates. This record describes the dataset; it does not distribute dataset data.
citation: Tran, R., et al. (2022). The Open Catalyst 2022 (OC22) Dataset and Challenges for Oxide Electrocatalysts. ACS Catalysis, 12(20), 12349–12363. https://doi.org/10.1021/acscatal.2c02434
